label: Prometheus
agentGuide: Instant query: GET /api/v1/query?query=<PromQL> (up, rate(http_requests_total[5m]), node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes); over time: GET /api/v1/query_range?query=...&start=<unix or RFC3339>&end=...&step=60s. What exists: GET /api/v1/label/__name__/values (metric names, long: filter with match[]), GET /api/v1/series?match[]=up, GET /api/v1/targets (scrape targets and their health), GET /api/v1/alerts (firing), GET /api/v1/rules. Answers are in data.result[] with metric labels and value [timestamp, "value"]. Keep ranges short and steps coarse: a range query can be huge.
